rule: New buildings and substantial conversion of existing buildings are outside the consumer rights directive; renovation and repair are inside.
key_sentence: for the construction of new buildings, the substantial conversion of existing buildings and for rental of accommodation for residential purposes

rule: A contract concluded with both parties present away from the trader's business premises is an off-premises contract.
key_sentence: in a place which is not the business premises of the trader

rule: Information and the copy of the signed contract go on paper or, if the consumer agrees, on another durable medium.
key_sentence: on paper or, if the consumer agrees, on another durable medium

rule: The consumer has 14 days to withdraw from a distance or off-premises contract without giving a reason.
key_sentence: the consumer shall have a period of 14 days to withdraw from a distance or off-premises contract, without giving any reason

rule: Without the withdrawal information the period expires 12 months after the end of the initial period.
key_sentence: the withdrawal period shall expire 12 months from the end of the initial withdrawal period

rule: Starting services inside the withdrawal period needs the consumer's express request on a durable medium and an acknowledgement that the right is lost on full performance.
key_sentence: the trader shall require that the consumer make such an express request on a durable medium

rule: A consumer who withdraws after such a request pays in proportion to what was provided; without the request or the information the consumer bears no cost.
key_sentence: in proportion to what has been provided until the time the consumer has informed the trader

rule: No withdrawal right for urgent repairs or maintenance the consumer specifically requested; additional services on the visit keep the right.
key_sentence: the right of withdrawal shall apply to those additional services or goods

rule: Member States may extend the period to 30 days for unsolicited visits to the home and sales excursions.
key_sentence: is extended to 30 days for contracts concluded in the context of unsolicited visits by a trader to a consumer's home

rule: The model instructions in Annex I(A), correctly filled in, satisfy the withdrawal information duty; Annex I(B) is the model form.
key_sentence: You have the right to withdraw from this contract within 14 days without giving any reason.

rule: Distance contracts concluded through an online interface must offer an online withdrawal function.
key_sentence: withdraw from contract here

rule: Goods installed by the seller: incorrect installation is a lack of conformity of the goods; the seller is liable for two years from delivery.
key_sentence: the installation forms part of the sales contract and was carried out by the seller or under the seller's responsibility

rule: A reduced VAT rate for renovation and repair of housing is an option for each Member State.
key_sentence: renovation and alteration, including demolition and reconstruction, and repairing of housing and private dwellings

rule: An electronic signature is not denied legal effect or admissibility solely because it is electronic; form requirements stay national.
key_sentence: An electronic signature shall not be denied legal effect and admissibility as evidence in legal proceedings solely on the grounds that it is in an electronic form

rule: Off-premises consumer contracts (signed away from the trader's premises, incl. at the consumer's home) fall under the distance/off-premises title of the TRLGDCU.
key_sentence: Contratos celebrados con la presencia física simultánea del empresario y del consumidor y usuario, en un lugar distinto al establecimiento mercantil del empresario.

rule: The off-premises title does not apply to new buildings or substantial transformation of existing buildings; ordinary renovation is not excluded.
key_sentence: A los contratos para la construcción de edificios nuevos, la transformación sustancial de edificios existentes y el alquiler de alojamientos para su uso como vivienda.

rule: The trader must give the art. 97.1 information before the consumer is bound, including withdrawal conditions and the withdrawal form.
key_sentence: Antes de que el consumidor y usuario quede vinculado por cualquier contrato a distancia o celebrado fuera del establecimiento

rule: Pre-contract information may be given through the Anexo I part A model.
key_sentence: podrá proporcionarse a través del modelo de documento de información al consumidor o usuario sobre el desistimiento establecido en la letra A del anexo I

rule: Information on paper or durable medium, in at least Castilian.
key_sentence: en papel o, si este está de acuerdo, en otro soporte duradero

rule: The consumer must receive a copy of the signed contract or its confirmation on paper or durable medium.
key_sentence: una copia del contrato firmado o la confirmación del mismo

rule: To start work within the withdrawal period the consumer must give an express request on a durable medium plus a declaration of losing withdrawal once fully performed.
key_sentence: una solicitud expresa solicitando el comienzo del contrato

rule: The trader bears the burden of proof and must identify the consumer unequivocally.
key_sentence: que le permitan identificar inequívocamente al consumidor y usuario con el que celebra el contrato

rule: Withdrawal period is 14 natural days, extended to 30 for contracts after unsolicited visits at the consumer's home.
key_sentence: el plazo de desistimiento se amplía a treinta días naturales

rule: Penalty clauses for exercising or waiving withdrawal are void.
key_sentence: Serán nulas de pleno derecho las cláusulas que impongan al consumidor y usuario una penalización por el ejercicio de su derecho de desistimiento o la renuncia al mismo.

rule: Withdrawal does not apply to services fully performed with the consumer's prior express consent and knowledge of losing the right.
key_sentence: habrá perdido su derecho de desistimiento

rule: No withdrawal for urgent repair or maintenance the consumer specifically asked for; withdrawal applies to additional services supplied on that visit.
key_sentence: operaciones de reparación o mantenimiento urgente

rule: For service contracts the withdrawal period runs from the day the contract is concluded.
key_sentence: El día de la celebración del contrato, en el caso de los contratos de servicios.

rule: If the withdrawal information was not given, the withdrawal period ends 12 months after the initial period.
key_sentence: el periodo de desistimiento finalizará doce meses después de la fecha de expiración del periodo de desistimiento inicial

rule: A consumer who withdraws after requesting early start pays a proportional amount for the part already provided.
key_sentence: abonará al empresario un importe proporcional a la parte ya prestada del servicio

rule: Anexo I part A (withdrawal information model) in force until 24 Jan 2027.
key_sentence: Tiene usted derecho a desistir del presente contrato en un plazo de catorce/treinta (*) días naturales sin necesidad de justificación.

rule: Anexo I part A new note (3), adding the online withdrawal function wording, applies from 25 Jan 2027 (RDL 44/2026 DF 4.9).
key_sentence: También puede ejercer su derecho de desistimiento en línea en

rule: Anexo I part B is the withdrawal form model; signature line only if presented on paper.
key_sentence: Firma del consumidor y usuario o de los consumidores y usuarios (solo si el presente formulario se presenta en papel)

rule: Providers of dwelling rehabilitation and repair services are under the special liability regime of art. 148.
key_sentence: servicios de rehabilitación y reparación de viviendas

rule: The TRLGDCU legal guarantee of conformity (arts. 114-127) excludes non-digital services.
key_sentence: La prestación de servicios distintos de los servicios digitales

rule: Until 30 Nov 2026 the 10 % VAT for dwelling renovation requires private-use individual or community of owners, works started 2 years after completion, and contractor materials not above 40 % of the taxable base.
key_sentence: Que la persona que realice las obras no aporte materiales para su ejecución o, en el caso de que los aporte, su coste no exceda del 40 por ciento de la base imponible de la operación.

rule: From 1 Dec 2026 the 10 % VAT also needs payment by card, transfer, nominative cheque or credit-institution deposit, and extends to dwellings let as habitual residence.
key_sentence: La aplicación del tipo reducido queda condicionada a que el importe de la contraprestación de las ejecuciones de obras haya sido satisfecho mediante tarjeta de crédito o débito, transferencia bancaria, cheque nominativo o ingreso en cuentas en entidades de crédito

rule: The customer's circumstances for the 10 % VAT can be proved by a written declaration signed by the customer and addressed to the contractor (private use, not a business, dwelling finished 2+ years before works).
key_sentence: podrán acreditarse mediante una declaración escrita firmada por el destinatario de las obras dirigida al sujeto pasivo

rule: Cataluña: a written prior quote is mandatory when the consumer cannot compute the price, unless waived by hand and signed.
source: Ley 22/2010 Código de consumo de Cataluña
key_sentence: salvo que esta renuncie a la elaboración del presupuesto expresamente, de forma manuscrita y con su firma

rule: Cataluña quote content: provider identity with NIF and address, object, itemised costs, validity period, start date and duration, quote date and signature, accept/reject dates with two equal signature spaces.
source: Ley 22/2010 Código de consumo de Cataluña
key_sentence: con espacios reservados para firmar cada una de las dos opciones, del mismo tamaño

rule: Cataluña: quote copies must be kept at least six months; the invoice cannot exceed the quote; extra items need a recorded extension accepted by the consumer.
source: Ley 22/2010 Código de consumo de Cataluña
key_sentence: debe hacer una ampliación o modificación, que debe comunicarse a la persona consumidora

rule: Cataluña: the services title includes services that supply materials when the service is the main part.
source: Ley 22/2010 Código de consumo de Cataluña
key_sentence: Se incluyen los servicios en que se aporten materiales o bienes, si la prestación del servicio tiene carácter principal.

rule: LOE reception is recorded in an acta signed at least by promotor and constructor with the five listed contents.
key_sentence: La recepción deberá consignarse en un acta firmada, al menos, por el promotor y el constructor

rule: Reception is deemed tacit if 30 days pass without written reservations or reasoned rejection; guarantee periods start at the acta or tacit reception.
key_sentence: La recepción se entenderá tácitamente producida si transcurridos treinta días desde la fecha indicada el promotor no hubiera puesto de manifiesto reservas o rechazo motivado por escrito.

rule: LOE liability periods: 10 years structural, 3 years habitability defects, 1 year finishing defects by the constructor.
key_sentence: Durante tres años, de los daños materiales causados en el edificio por vicios o defectos de los elementos constructivos o de las instalaciones

rule: LOE covers interventions on existing buildings only when they alter the architectural configuration (total, essential change of exterior, volume or structure, or change of use).
key_sentence: Todas las intervenciones sobre los edificios existentes, siempre y cuando alteren su configuración arquitectónica
